messages:
Nora: Heads-up 10-day POC with PayLayer. They want a production-like load test: 750 QPS peak chat, avg 150 tokens in / 180 out (330 total). Embeddings are 5% of traffic. Start May 15. Need reserved GPU recommendation, autoscale guardrails, preheat plan, and quick security bullet points for procurement.

Diego: Clarify: are peaks typically 1-3m bursts or sustained 10m? model target?

Nora: They expect 3-6 minute promo bursts. Preferred model: 13B quant for cost, optional fallback to a 30B distilled variant if quality fails.

Rina: Ballpark calc:
```
peak_qps=750
tokens=330
tokens_per_sec=247500 t/s
13B_quant ~50k t/s per GPU => ~5 GPUs (247500/50k=4.95)
30B_distill ~28k t/s per GPU => ~9 GPUs
```
Recommend commit baseline 5 GPUs for 13B, with burst to 8 (2-3 extra) for headroom and canary. If they insist on 30B at peak, call out ~9-10 GPUs.

Corey: Autoscale policy suggestion: commit=5, min_reserved=3, burst_limit=3 (max 8), step=1 GPU, cooldown=90s. Route: reserved pool -> burst pool -> throttling at queue length 150. Prewarm: persistent KV caching + preheat top 150 prefixes 4h before promo window.

Diego: Ops notes: enable prefix cache, set embeddings batching aggressive, and limit decode tokens per request with soft cap to reduce tail risk. Add a fallback model chain: 13B primary, 30B-distill fallback only for quality, not latency-triggered (to avoid cost spikes).

Nora: Procurement asked: delta pricing reserved vs burst, and cost to keep a prewarm slot 24/7.

Corey: Internal ballpark: reserved GPU monthly ~"$5.5k" each (13B-equivalent). Burst on-demand ~1.6x reserved. Prewarm slot = charged as normal GPU hours when running; 24/7 prewarm = 1 GPU full-month cost. Mark finance to confirm.

Rina: Sensitivity table we should include: seq length +/-30% -> GPUs change +/-2; KV hit-rate 0.2->0.4 reduces decode load ~15%. We'll attach simple numbers.

Nora: Security bullets they want: EU data residency, SOC2, KMS/CMK support, audit logs retention, BAA.

Diego: Responses: EU region available; SOC2 Type II report on request; CMK via Private or VPC offering; default audit logs 90 days (extendable); BAA requires legal sign-off (5-10 business days typical). Call out HSM/Crypto requirements need extra lead time.

infra-bot: preheat-scheduler: created preheat job for 2024-05-14T22:00Z (top-150 prefixes, duration 4h).

Nora: Good. Action items:
- Rina: sizing slide + sensitivity rows (due EOD tomorrow)
- Corey: ops runbook + prewarm checklist (draft by tomorrow 11am PT)
- Diego: security bullets + legal intake (BAA estimate)
- Nora: assemble one-pager and SOW snippet

Rina: ack. Corey: ack. Diego: ack. Nora: thanks, will update the deal doc and loop finance.
